hiw.hero_title: Built By Students: Why MatchMax Works Better
hiw.hero_body: MatchMax was founded by recent IB and DSE graduates to fix a broken system. Traditional agencies take massive cuts, driving up costs for families and underpaying educators. We believe that when an agency takes less, everyone wins. By strictly limiting our commission to just the first one and a half lessons, we make elite tutoring more accessible for parents and significantly more rewarding for tutors. As a high-touch concierge, we also personally manage your onboarding and your first 2 lessons, then step back and leave parents and tutors to run the ongoing schedule directly. When you use MatchMax, you aren't just finding a tutor—you are directly supporting dedicated educators in a fairer, transparent community.

commission.old: Agencies take the first 2 to 8 lessons.
commission.detail: MatchMax takes 1.5 lessons per successful match. The tutor keeps the rest.

screening.detail: Transcripts are checked before a card goes live.

fit.detail: Matches consider curriculum, subject score, school, and MTR line — not just a district.

privacy.detail: The public card shows no full name.

hiw.flow_title: The New Standard for Tutor Matching.
hiw.flow_body: We manually verify every top scorer and school examiner so you don't have to. Experience Hong Kong's most transparent, easy-to-use platform for finding and comparing premium tutors. Once you are matched, our concierge team actively manages the communication for your first 2 lessons—then parents and tutors take over the ongoing schedule directly.
hiw.flow_oneliner: MatchMax manages the introduction and the first two lessons. The ongoing schedule is between parent and tutor.
hiw.parents_title: Manually verified top scorers, transparent paper scores, zero guesswork.

s1.title: Browse Premium, Verified Profiles
s1.detail: We enforce a strictly high academic bar. Browse clean, easy-to-read profiles featuring manually verified transcripts, exact paper scores, and secondary school backgrounds. No vague claims—just proven results under "Achievements and Experiences".

s2.title: Compare & Request Seamlessly
s2.detail: Treat tutor hunting like simple online shopping. Add candidates to your shortlist, compare their "Subjects Taught" and credentials side-by-side, and submit your lesson preferences with zero hassle.

s3.title: Meet & Settle

You pay MatchMax by FPS and staff release the file inside your account, with a 20% platform fee supporting the creator. After three paid lessons, ask MatchMax and staff can grant that tutor's current packs.

hiw.tutors_title: Maximise your earning potential with Hong Kong's most tutor-friendly platform.

s1.title: Submit Your Credentials

s2.title: Manual Verification & Anonymous Listing
s2.detail: Our team manually checks your documents to maintain our premium standard. Your profile goes live completely anonymously—your full name and sensitive details remain 100% private.

s3.title: Teach & Keep What You Earn
s3.detail: Accept student requests that fit your schedule and commute. Keep 100% of your earnings after a fair, transparent 1.5-lesson platform fee—no massive agency commission cuts.

s4.title: Passive Income with Digital Notes

paid.q: How much is the MatchMax commission?
paid.a: MatchMax is entirely free to join. For standard, ongoing tutoring cases, we charge a one-time administrative fee equivalent to your first 1.5 lessons. You keep 100% of your earnings for every lesson after that. For Short-Term Cases: If a parent explicitly requests a short-term assignment (defined as 5 lessons or fewer), our fee is automatically adjusted to just 20% of the total assignment value, so you always retain an 80% majority cut.

anonymity.q: Will my name and photo be publicly visible on Google?
anonymity.a: No. MatchMax respects the privacy of our top scholars and university students. Your public directory profile is completely anonymous and focuses solely on your academic achievements. Furthermore, our concierge team will only ever introduce you to parents using your last name (e.g., “Tutor Chan”). You have complete control over sharing your full name once your lessons begin.

speed.q: How many days does it usually take to find students?
speed.a: Matching speed depends on subject demand, your profile quality, and availability. Many tutors receive relevant student matching requests within 1 to 2 weeks.

rates.a: Usual market rates typically range between HK$300 to HK$600 per hour. However, rates vary depending on lesson mode (online vs. in-person), duration, level, subject complexity, and your academic background. Tutors can discuss and negotiate rates directly with parents to agree on a fair fee.

experience.q: Do I need teaching experience to join?
experience.a: Prior experience helps, but strong academic results, clear communication skills, and a complete profile are equally important for verification and student matching.

modes.q: Can I teach both online and in person?
modes.a: Yes. You can set your preferred lesson modes and target locations in your profile and update them anytime as your schedule changes.

after_trial.q: How do payments work after the trial lessons?
after_trial.a: To give you full financial control and ensure you keep 100% of your earnings, all ongoing lesson fees are paid directly from the parent to you using your preferred method. Because you manage your own ongoing schedule and billing, we recommend collecting payment on a lesson-by-lesson basis or upfront for the month. If a payment issue ever arises, you can report it to our team; while we do not act as a collection agency, we take community safety seriously and will restrict non-paying users from future matching.

negotiate.a: Yes, rates can be negotiated, but any adjustments depend entirely on the tutor's willingness and policy. Factors such as lesson frequency, online vs. in-person mode, travel distance, and lesson length may give room for discussion directly with the tutor.

trial.q: Can I arrange a trial lesson before committing to a regular schedule?
trial.a: Yes. Parents are welcome to request an initial single trial lesson. Whether a trial lesson is offered and its specific terms (paid or discounted) depend entirely on the individual tutor's willingness and policy, which you can confirm directly before starting.

matching.a: You have two straightforward options: you can click forward directly on any tutor's profile card to request that specific tutor, or reach out to our WhatsApp hotline and tell us exactly what you are looking for so we can match you. Once confirmed, we connect you directly with the tutor to finalize lesson times.

anonymity.q: Why don't I see the tutors' full names on their profiles?
anonymity.a: To attract the highest tier of university scholars and official examiners—many of whom require strict privacy and prefer not to have their tutoring profiles publicly searchable—MatchMax utilizes anonymous profiles (e.g., “MM-T104”). Once you request a specific profile, our concierge team will introduce you to your match using their professional title and last name (e.g., “Tutor Chan” or “Miss Lee”) to arrange the trial lesson.

involvement.q: How long does MatchMax stay involved in our tutoring arrangement?
involvement.a: MatchMax operates as a high-touch concierge matching service. We actively oversee your onboarding, ensure your trial lesson goes smoothly, and manage the communication for your first 2 lessons until the administrative matching fee is settled. Once this initial matching phase is successfully completed, MatchMax steps back, leaving parents and tutors to manage their ongoing schedule directly.

verification.q: How does MatchMax verify tutor qualifications and grades?
verification.a: MatchMax uses a two-tier system. Tier 1 tutors list self-reported results as “Stated Qualifications”—MatchMax does not cryptographically verify these claims, so you can request photographic proof directly from the tutor before the first lesson. Tier 2 tutors carry the gold Verified Scholar Badge, meaning our team has manually checked their identity and academic documents. Either way, you can always ask for proof before committing.

payments.q: How do payments work between parents and tutors?
payments.a: Tuition is paid directly to the tutor based on the agreed hourly rate and schedule. MatchMax does not hold or handle your tuition fees, keeping the payment process direct and transparent.

pay.q: How and when do I pay for the lessons?
pay.a: MatchMax charges one administrative matching fee, settled once by FPS after your first two lessons. Our concierge stays close for those first two lessons and makes sure the match is right; once you are happy, you pay the fee. For standard ongoing cases the fee equals the cost of 1.5 lessons; for short-term assignments (5 lessons or fewer) it is strictly 20% of the total scheduled package. After the fee is settled, you pay your tutor directly for every remaining lesson.

rematch.q: What if the tutor isn't a good fit after the first lesson?
rematch.a: We offer a First-Lesson Free Rematch Guarantee. If you feel the tutor is not the perfect match for your child, simply compensate the tutor directly for that single hour of teaching, and MatchMax will immediately waive our administrative fee to personally hand-select a new, better-suited candidate for you at no additional platform cost.

reschedule.q: What happens if my child is sick or we need to reschedule?
reschedule.a: We understand that schedules change and emergencies happen. We simply ask that parents and tutors communicate directly in your dedicated MatchMax WhatsApp group and aim to provide at least 24 hours' notice out of mutual respect.

account.q: Do I need an account to request a tutor?
account.a: Browsing is free and open — you can look at tutors, guides, and study notes without an account. To submit a request you sign in with Google, one tap, so the concierge knows who to contact and can manage your case.

notes.q: How do purchases of digital study materials work?
notes.a: Study materials are sold through MatchMax. You pay the full amount to the MatchMax official business account via FPS, and staff release the file inside your account before the tutor receives their 80% share on the 1st of the following month (MatchMax retains a 20% platform commission). Because digital files cannot be returned, all sales are final—please review the free watermarked preview before purchasing.

parents.intro: Everything a parent needs: how matching works, what you pay, and what MatchMax does not do.
parents.s1_title: Browse verified cards or send a request
parents.s1_body: Search the verified tutor cards by subject, station, and budget — or submit a case request and let the concierge shortlist for you.
parents.s2_title: We introduce a tutor and stay close
parents.s2_body: We check the tutor's documents, make the introduction, and stay involved for the first two lessons.
parents.s3_body: After the first two lessons, pay the admin fee by FPS. It equals 1.5 lessons — that is the only fee MatchMax keeps.
parents.s4_title: Pay the tutor directly after that
parents.s4_body: From the third lesson on, you settle the tutor's hourly rate directly. MatchMax steps out of the schedule.
parents.fact_rates_body: Tutors set their own hourly rates. What the card shows is what the tutor charges — we do not mark it up.
parents.fact_names_label: Names stay off the public card
parents.fact_names_body: Cards show first names only. You get the tutor's full name when the concierge makes the introduction.
parents.fact_fit_label: A poor fit can be replaced
parents.fact_fit_body: If the fit is wrong after lesson one, tell the concierge and we will arrange a replacement tutor.
parents.fact_sickness_label: Sickness is rescheduled with the tutor
parents.fact_sickness_body: A lesson missed through sickness is rescheduled directly with the tutor — nobody loses the money.
parents.fact_account_label: A Google sign-in is needed to request
parents.fact_account_body: Browsing is free and open. Submitting a case request needs a quick Google sign-in so the concierge knows who to contact.
parents.not_lessons_label: We don't sit in after lesson two
parents.not_lessons_body: The concierge stays close for the first two lessons. Once the fee is paid, the arrangement is between you and the tutor.
parents.not_cut_label: We don't take a cut of later lessons
parents.not_cut_body: The 1.5-lesson admin fee is the only money MatchMax keeps. Every later lesson is paid straight to the tutor.
parents.not_schedule_body: Rescheduling and the ongoing timetable are arranged directly with the tutor.

tutors.intro: Everything a tutor needs: how listing works, what the commission really is, and what MatchMax does not do.
tutors.s1_body: Send your transcript, component scores, and the MTR stations that work for you.
tutors.s2_title: We check, then list you anonymously
tutors.s2_body: We check your documents manually. Your card goes live without your photo or full name.
tutors.s3_title: Claim cases that fit the commute
tutors.s3_body: Browse the open case board and claim the cases near your stations. The first two lessons run with us on call.
tutors.s4_title: Keep the hourly pay after the admin fee
tutors.s4_body: After two lessons and the 1.5-lesson admin fee, the hourly pay is yours. The commission is 1.5 lessons — not a cut of later lessons.
tutors.fact_commission_body: MatchMax takes 1.5 lessons per successful match. Every lesson after that is paid straight to you.
tutors.fact_privacy_label: Your photo and full name stay private
tutors.fact_privacy_body: The public card is anonymous. The parent learns your full name only at the introduction.
tutors.fact_modes_label: Online and in person are both allowed
tutors.fact_modes_body: Offer either or both, and filter cases by the stations you can reach.
tutors.fact_experience_label: No experience minimum beyond the academic bar
tutors.fact_experience_body: If your grades clear the verification bar, you can list. Teaching experience is not required.
tutors.not_cut_label: We don't take a percentage of your pay
tutors.not_cut_body: There is no percentage model. The 1.5-lesson admin fee per match is everything we take.
tutors.not_clients_body: After the introduction and the fee, the student is yours. We do not re-market to your student or take them back.
tutors.not_schedule_body: You and the parent arrange lesson times directly. We stay out of the scheduling.

notes.intro: Original study packs from verified tutors, checked by our team before they go on sale. This page also carries the ban list — what can never be sold here.
notes.s1_title: The tutor uploads an original pack
notes.s1_body: Only verified (Tier 2) tutors can upload. Every pack must be the tutor's own work or carry written permission.
notes.s2_body: Staff review each pack against the rules below before it is listed. Anything on the ban list is rejected.
notes.s3_title: The parent pays MatchMax by FPS
notes.s3_body: The buyer pays MatchMax, not the tutor — the pack is released only after the payment clears.
notes.s4_title: Staff release the file to the buyer
notes.s4_body: The file is delivered inside the buyer's account, stamped with the order. The tutor never sees the buyer's phone number; the buyer never sees the tutor's.
notes.s5_title: The tutor is paid on the monthly run
notes.s5_body: MatchMax keeps 20%. The tutor's net is paid by FPS in the monthly payout run.
notes.allowed_examples: Original worked examples and original mock questions.
notes.allowed_checklists: Marking checklists in the tutor's own words.
notes.allowed_exemplar: An IA or EE exemplar only with the student's written permission, names removed, labelled “exemplar, not for submission”.
notes.banned_school_papers: School internal tests, mocks, or answer keys.
notes.banned_hkeaa: HKEAA DSE, TSA, HKCEE, or HKALE papers or marking schemes.
notes.banned_ib: IB past papers, markschemes, questionbanks, or the last two exam sessions.
notes.banned_classmate: Another student's IA, EE, or TOK work without written permission.
notes.banned_contact: A file with a phone number, WhatsApp, Instagram, or QR code inside.
notes.enforcement_reject: Staff reject banned uploads — the listing never goes live.
notes.enforcement_repeat: Repeat uploads close the tutor's notes privilege.
notes.enforcement_remove: MatchMax may remove a pack and refund the buyer at any time.
notes.upload_note: Tutors: uploading means you accept the Notes Terms. The upload form cannot be submitted without accepting them.

refer.intro: Share your link, your friend applies as a tutor, and you earn 15% of the MatchMax admin fee on their first successful case. No WhatsApp messages — the link does the counting.
refer.s1_body: Your Refer & Earn dashboard shows your unique link. Copy it and send it to your friend.
refer.s2_body: They must open your link and submit the tutor application from it. A later mention on WhatsApp does not count.
refer.s3_body: On submit, the applicant is stored as referred by your account. One referrer only — the first link wins.
refer.s4_body: The bounty unlocks when their first case finishes two lessons and the admin fee is marked paid.
refer.s5_body: We pay 15% of the MatchMax admin fee — not of the tutor's hourly pay — by FPS on the monthly run.
refer.rule_bounty: Reward: 15% of the MatchMax admin fee on the referred tutor's first successful case. If the fee is 1.5 × HK$400, the bounty is 15% of that fee — never 15% of the tutor's hourly rate.
refer.rule_what_counts: Attribution: the friend must open your link and apply through it. The link attributes for 90 days. One referrer only, first link wins.
refer.rule_when: Payable only after lesson 1 and lesson 2 are done and the fee is marked paid. A waive, refund, or replacement before payment pays nothing.
refer.rule_how_paid: Paid by FPS on the monthly run. You are notified when the tutor is approved, when their first case is matched, and when the bounty is paid.
refer.exclusion_already: A tutor who is already approved on MatchMax.
refer.exclusion_second: A second account belonging to the same person.
refer.exclusion_whatsapp: A WhatsApp mention after the fact — only the link counts.
refer.fee_link: How the admin fee is calculated (15% is of this, not the hourly rate)
refer.dashboard_note: Your dashboard shows your link, referred tutors, and bounty status: pending, payable, paid, void.

verification.intro: Every tutor card is checked by a person before it goes live. Here is exactly what we verify — and what verification does not mean.
verification.tier2_body: Tier 2 is our top verification bar. Tutors submit their official academic transcripts and Hong Kong Identity Card (HKID), and a staff member cross-checks every document by hand. Approved tutors carry the gold Verified Scholar Badge on their card.
verification.tier1_body: Tier 1 tutors list self-reported results as stated qualifications. These claims are not cryptographically verified, so you can always ask the tutor for photographic proof before the first lesson.
verification.professionals_body: Working professionals are judged on their degree, PGDE, and tutoring record rather than a single exam score.
verification.p1_body: Transcripts, component scores, and identity documents go through the join flow.
verification.p2_body: A staff member reviews every document against the tier bar, and may ask for more before approving.
verification.p3_body: Your card publishes with its verification tier shown. Tier 2 (Verified) requires the top academic bar.
verification.not_grade: We do not guarantee a grade.
verification.not_offer: We do not guarantee a school or university offer.
verification.not_marking: We do not vouch for a tutor's marking style.
verification.not_endorsement: MatchMax is not endorsed by the IB, HKEAA, or any school.

notes_terms.title: Notes Terms
notes_terms.role_title: MatchMax's role and the licence chain
notes_terms.role_body: MatchMax sells a digital file to the buyer. The selling tutor warrants that they own the material — or hold written permission — and licenses the file to MatchMax for sale. The tutor is an independent seller; MatchMax is not the tutor's agent.
notes_terms.warranty_title: The tutor's warranty and the ban list
notes_terms.warranty_body: Every upload warrants that the material is the tutor's own work or carries written permission, and that it is not on the ban list. The ban list is published on the notes guide and includes:
notes_terms.licence_body: A purchase grants a personal licence: one student, no resale, no class set, no uploading elsewhere. Sharing the file beyond the buyer's own use ends the licence.
notes_terms.delivery_body: Files are delivered inside the buyer's account after staff mark the FPS payment as received. The receipt email contains no file. Each file is stamped with the order and account identifiers.
notes_terms.refund_body: Before the file is released, a refund is full. After release, refunds are limited to a bad file — corrupt or substantially not as described — or a file that breaches the ban list.
notes_terms.takedown_body: We may remove a pack and refund buyers if a rights holder complains. Repeat banned uploads close the tutor's notes privilege; serious breaches suspend selling altogether.
notes_terms.affiliation_body: MatchMax is not affiliated with the IB, HKEAA, or any school. Nothing in these terms promises a grade, an offer, or that a school will accept the notes.
notes_terms.law_body: These terms are governed by the laws of Hong Kong.
